title: Cache payload evolution: mixed readers, validated translation and versioned namespaces
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Read mixed cache payloads; identify when translation or versioned namespaces are required.
sourceAcceptance: Compatible translation/versioning preserves correctness; incompatible cached objects fail explicitly.
preconditions: A modern browser supporting local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Two fixed synthetic readers v1/v2, four reads, two serialized schemas and an exact USD 1250 minor-unit invariant.
Versioned namespaces are both pre-populated with their fixed own-version fixture.
No account, cache service, server, credentials, framework or Azure subscription.
actions: Choose shared or versioned keys, translation, payload and observation coverage.
Prepare to lock assumptions, then read four fixed synthetic objects.
Inspect received payloads, decoded values, explicit failure reasons and unknowns.
Check a prediction separately from the measured cache gate and synthetic impact.
Start another attempt with retained history or explicitly reset all in-memory state.
assertions: A shared key without translation produces two explicit cross-schema failures.
Validated translation preserves both reader contracts and all expected values.
Versioned namespaces preserve coexistence without cross-schema reads.
Malformed and schema-valid wrong-value objects fail even with versioning or translation.
Unobserved reads remain unknown; known failures dominate an incomplete gate.
Exact configuration, lifecycle, immutable state and six-attempt history are guarded.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED and before behavior implementation
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; cloud/IaC/scaffold/identity/deploy/spend are not authorized.

testRuntime.purpose: Existing Node22 tooling only; not production Node24 certification.

limits: Every cache key, serialized object, write, read, translation and outcome is synthetic.
No real cache/service, native Azure, source-parent, production24 or five-nines proof.
Real cache warming, synchronization, freshness, expiry, races and invalidation are unverified.
History retains at most six completed attempts in memory; explicit reset or reload erases it.
The published browser helper's known unattended lifecycle limitation remains unqualified.
B-S055 and D-S055 native acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
Only learning/S055 is owned; one frozen S unit, no extra test/plumbing/refinement credit.
